title: ID Scanner
description: Counts as an extra **defending squad** when rolling for **repel** or **recruit**.
flavour: "Ain't no one getting through less da blooper sez bloop" - Marv

title: Assault Rifles
description: Counts as an extra **squad** when rolling for **attack** or **defence**.
flavour: Talon Industries new X4 model has several hot-swap fire profiles to suit almost any situation - Talon Ind.

title: Workshop Tools
description: Allows any friendly squad in the same location to perform the **construct action**.
flavour: "Look do you want it fixed or do you want it quickly?" - Unknown source

title: Mass Driver
specialAbilities: Target takes 4 hits cannot perform any action or ability for 1 turn

title: Linked Lasers
specialAbilities: If 2 critical hits are scored, target rig site catches fire

title: Tracker Cannon
specialAbilities: Re-roll misses for subsequent weapons in this attack

title: Piston Actuated Walker
description: Grants **movement** when paired with any other working walker tech.

title: All-terrain Track
description: Grants **movement**. Supported weight doubles when paired with any other working crawler tech.

title: Flight Boosters
description: Grants **movement**. If flight boosters ever stop working, it causes the rig to **crash**.

title: Utility Cockpit
description: Grants **targeting** ability.

title: Solar Harvester
description: Construction requires you control an **Orbital Platform**. Once per turn use an ability of a **Low Orbit** facility one additional time.

title: Empire Portal
description: Construction requires you control a **Solar Harvester**. Summon the **Empire Invasion** providing one is not already in-play.

title: Cyber Warfare Array
description: If you control an **Orbital Platform**: Once per turn carry out **Espionage** successfully on a base of your choosing.

title: Planetary Venting Infrastructure
description: While functional this facility doubles the resources retrieved when any player performs the **Gather** action in any location.
flavour: Planet-wide ventilation was such a vast undertaking but now we can reap the benefits of those countless shafts we had to bore - Octo Mining Corp

title: Experimental Core Vent
description: Construction requires you control **Planetary Venting Infrastructure**.\nPermanently halve the cost of turning **scrap** into **resource** for all players.
flavour: Besides all we learnt about the core, the lasting side effect of the experiment was the long-barren test site suddenly became fertile again - Core Tech

title: Stable Core Reactor
description: Construction requires **Experimental Core Vent** exists. If this facility is functional for **2 consecutive turns** you may attempt to discover **Infinite Power**.
flavour: A stable singularity represents near infinite energy and so we enter the most singularly unstable moment in our people's history - Dr Enzo Sidius

title: Planetary Hyperloop
description: Construction requires you control **Planetary Venting Infrastructure**. While functional squads you control can travel to any **Basic Location, Barren Wastes or Base** in one action.

title: Arc Shield Generator
description: If you control **Planetary Venting Infrastructure**: Once per turn prevent all attacks for the rest of the turn in one location.

title: Fire Control Drones
description: A squad with this equipped can, as an action, attempt to **Fight Fire** in their location.
flavour: While too delicate for offensive action the drone has become an invaluable support tool in modern warfare - War: 2.0

title: Smoke Grenades
description: When attacked a squad can use this equipment to negate all hits. At the end of the attackers actions the expended equipment is removed from the squad.

title: Armoured Haulage
description: Unlocks the squad's **three armoured resource slots**. When attacked, negate one hit per resource in these slots without losing the resources.

title: Redundancy Systems
description: Grants the **targeting** ability. If the **movement** ability is lost return the rig to its home base.

title: CO2 Dispersal System
description: Grants the **targeting** ability. As an action the rig may attempt to **fight fire** on its other parts.
